Added `just sync-vendor-mngr-live`, which rsyncs this checkout's live working tree (uncommitted changes included) into a default-workspace-template worktree's `system/vendor/mngr/`. This is the sync `just minds-start` already did inline at launch, now callable on its own so you can re-sync without relaunching the app. `just sync-vendor-mngr` is unchanged and remains the release path (vendors `git archive HEAD` and commits).

Documented in `CLAUDE.md` what to do when a base-branch merge in the default-workspace-template worktree is blocked by that vendored copy. The stop hook exempts `system/vendor/mngr` from its commit check, but git still refuses to merge over it; the hook now reports that case distinctly ("Merge blocked by uncommitted changes under an exempt path") rather than as a merge conflict. The fix is to drop the generated copy, merge, and re-run `just sync-vendor-mngr-live` -- never to commit it or resolve it as a conflict.
